title: Portal Second Age: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Course he ran! *I* wouldn't want to stare down that barrel, either!" —Alaborn soldier
"Ever proud, ever vigilant." —Grenadier motto
Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.
"I dedicate my body to my country And my life to my King." —Alaborn Soldier's Oath
The man who rose up to fight was not the same man knocked down.
Be at peace, and observe its beauty. Be at war, and feel its justice.
War destroys more than just the land. War destroys hope.
Bargaining with a goblin is like trading with a child; both believe they already own everything.
Everyone loves a good sale.
"You could die famous or you could die old. I chose old." —Former soldier
"Bravery shines brightest in a pure soul." —Restela, Alaborn marshal
"You idiots! Turn it around! Turn it around!"
Young, yes. Inexperienced, yes. Weak? Don't count on it.
"Give us breath. Give us life. Prepare us for the day we make." —The Alaborn "Rite of Battle"
"So he gots a sword. Big deal." "Yeah, it's a big deal—it's a big sword!" —Two goblins outside the gates of Trokin
Battle tempers soldiers as fire tempers steel.
A bullet renders all sizes equal.
People fight hardest on their own soil.
Two little goblins, out in the sun. Down came a griffin, and then there was one.
As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.
"Information equals profits. Our merchants sell it, or our pirates use it." —Jefan, Talas ship captain
History is the study of repetition.
The sea gives, and the sea takes. Some just help with the taking.
"Is it merchants or is it pirates?" "It's Talas—there's no difference."
"Their ships pollute our air as they themselves pollute our forest." —Arathel, elvish queen
The trader let loose a laugh that made all around him check their purses.
From time, knowledge. From knowledge, power.
"Scouting a battle before you fight it is just good business." —Jefan, Talas ship captain
The sea is in their blood. Literally.
Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.
"First they fight, then they sleep, then they dream. And finally I receive my reward."
Four little goblins, trapped by the sea. One teased a serpent, and then there were three.
"The ogre had come from out of the blue, so that's where I sent it back." —Talas wizard
"I don't want what I don't have. I want more of what I *do* have."
It pays to be at home both on the sea *and* in the sky.
"Knowledge demands sacrifice." —Tojira, swamp queen
"I have all the weapons my enemies have—and far deeper rage." —Tojira, swamp queen
When nightstalkers sing, nothing in creation sleeps.
"Human tenderness is simply weakness in a pretty package." —Tojira, swamp queen
"Such a fragile organ, the brain." —Tojira, swamp queen
The bat thrives on what underestimates it.
The tiniest cough can be deadlier than the fiercest dragon.
A scorpion this big you won't find curled up in your boot. Maybe *around* your boot, but not *in* it.
"Our greatest hope has become our enemy's greatest triumph." —Restela, Alaborn marshal
The touch of death is never gentle.
"I'd sooner lock lips with a viper. At least I might walk away from *that*." —Elvish scout
The shadows know.
The dead sing their own lullabies.
"Just as some fool said it couldn't get worse, the rats began to show up." —Alaborn soldier
Part metal, part bone, and all death.
Silent as a serpent, twisted as a lone bog tree, evil as Tojira's heart.
"Our steeds need food, water, stabling. Theirs just need prey." —Restela, Alaborn marshal
Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.
"Life from death is part of the natural cycle. This is merely a shortcut." —Tojira, swamp queen
"This isn't what I meant by 'facing the heat of battle!'" —Jefan, Talas ship captain
They get along so well with their goats because they're practically goats themselves.
Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.
The goblins call the gliders "death from above." Everyone else calls them "clods in the clouds."
"I done forgot more than you'll ever know, pipsqueak." "Yeah—that's your problem."
Goblin mountaineer, barely keeps his family fed.
Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.
"I seen lots o' fights. To win ya gotta bash hard and not get bashed back." —Goblin grunt
"Goblins cry, soldiers fly. Stones fly, soldiers die!"
Meant to cut through the body and burn straight to the soul.
After a while, ships stopped sailing within his reach.
The machine does the growling, so the ogre's free to smile.
Three little goblins, enjoying their brew. One bumped an ogre, and then there were two.
Assault and battery included.
He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.
There goes the neighborhood!
One little goblin shook up the ground. When the dust cleared, no one was found.
Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.
No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.
In its lair lies a carpet of bones.
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it. —Elvish saying
Busy as a bumblebee, blistered as a goblin. —Alaborn saying
The elvish scout was scrupulous about the truth. She told the traders that gold lay nearby.
The good news is it's vegetarian. The bad news is it just doesn't like you.
Rarely seen, hardly heard, never caught.
The nightstalkers' little game of tease-the-squirrel suddenly took an unexpected turn.
The dying ask for water because they know it contains life.
"Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us." —Arathel, elvish queen
"'Air superiority?' Not while our archers scan the skies." —Elvish scout
Some trees bear deadly fruit.
"Trade my moose? Sure—when I find a *horse* that can spear ten goblins at a time!"
"The woods hold peace for those who desire it, but those who seek battle will find me."
"I'd hate to see the bird that could get *this* wurm!" —Alaborn soldier
One razorclaw is three bears too many. —Elvish saying
Death just encourages life the more.
The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.
"What was taken shall be restored." —Arathel, elvish queen
The deeper the wood, the greater its strength.
"They serve the world best on a platter with shallots and onions." —Talas sailor
It has the run of the swamps, and it knows it.
